GRUB_DEFAULT.description: The default boot entry for GRUB. Can be a number, menuentry title, or 'saved'.

GRUB_TIMEOUT.description: Time in seconds that GRUB will wait before booting the default entry.

GRUB_TIMEOUT_STYLE.description: The style of the GRUB menu display. Can be 'menu', 'hidden', 'countdown', or 'hidden_countdown'.

GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT.description: Default parameters appended to the Linux kernel command line for normal boots.

GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX.description: Additional parameters appended to the Linux kernel command line for all boots.
